title: Common
description: Definitions shared by every IR schema. See core/schema/README.md.

id.title: Id
id.description: Project-unique entity id (convention 9). Immutable and never reused.

state.title: State
state.description: Authorship state of a field or list (D25).

origin.title: Origin
origin.description: Who inserted the entity: a user (including approved or dictated session edits) or an agent or job. Set by the store.

entity_lock.title: EntityLock
entity_lock.description: Present only when the whole entity and its subtree are locked (convention 8).

frames.title: Frames
frames.description: A time or duration in integer frames at the project rate (D27).

frame_offset.title: FrameOffset
frame_offset.description: A signed offset in integer frames.

samples.title: Samples
samples.description: An audio offset in integer samples at the profile's sample rate (D27).

rational.title: Rational
rational.description: A rational number such as a frame rate (30000/1001).

hash.title: Hash
hash.description: SHA-256 over the hash form (IR data) or over the bytes (assets).

token_path.title: TokenPath
token_path.description: A dotted style token path, such as palette.accent.

token_ref.title: TokenRef
token_ref.description: A reference to a style token, resolved by the cascade (M1.3).

token_value.title: TokenValue
token_value.description: A literal token value or a reference to another token.

anchor.title: Anchor
anchor.description: A timing anchor (convention 15): a line's start, end or word, plus a frame offset. `word` is present exactly when `point` is `word`.

license.title: License
license.description: Output license terms of an asset or plugin.
